verdict.rationale: Simular says Sai reruns taught workflows on a schedule and keeps working after you close the laptop, notifying you via iMessage or Telegram only when it needs you. Saved workflows replay as code and self-heal when the UI changes. Tasks run on hosted cloud computers, up to 5 at a time, with sessions persisting, though approval gates still pause the run before sensitive steps. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring schedules and triggers (only marketing-level mentions), and independent or hands-on confirmation that unattended background runs work reliably.
